title: Admissibility and precise uniform bounds for smooth chart towers
statement:
Fix a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. All schemes below are separated of finite type over $k$, and all morphisms are $k$-morphisms. Put $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\ell^n$ for $n\ge1$. For a scheme $T$ use the ordinary derived category $D(\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E))$ of strict varying-coefficient towers [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. Write $\mathcal C_T$ for its full subcategory whose levels have bounded intrinsically constructible cohomology and finite Tor amplitude, in common intervals independent of $n$ [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers, def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf, def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude]. No normalization is required. At level $n$ write $\mathcal C_{T,n}=D^b_{ctf}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A_n)$ in the ordinary constant-ring module derived category. For each separated finite-type map $h$ choose a coefficient-independent compactification and write $F_h=Rh_{!,\bullet}$ and $F_{h,n}=Rh_{!,A_n}$ [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels].

Let $f:X\to Y$ be smooth of pure relative dimension $d\ge0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $K\in\mathcal C_Y$ have cohomology in $[a,b]$ and Tor amplitude in $[u,v]$ at every level. Then the following assertions hold.

(1) All schemes here and their opens are Noetherian and qcqs. Writing $\ell=t\varpi_E^e$ with $t$ a unit gives $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{en}$, a finite Noetherian ring. Every object of $\mathcal C_{T,n}$ has an etale-origin representative, meaning it is isomorphic to $\nu_T^*L$ for $L\in D^b_{ctf}(T_{\mathrm{et}},A_n)$, where $\nu_T$ is the etale/pro-etale comparison [det-pe-finite-tor-comparison-noetherian]. Every specified Tor interval can be retained for $L$. These witnesses are separate levelwise witnesses, with no compatibility assumption. The tower $K$ is bounded below in the ordinary derived tower category.

(2) For every coordinate chart $f|_U=p_de$ with $e:U\to\mathbf A^d_Y$ separated etale of finite type and $p_d:\mathbf A^d_Y\to Y$, the actual derived tower $H_UK=e_\bullet^*p_{d,\bullet}^*K(d)[2d]$ has intrinsically constructible levels, cohomological interval $[a-2d,b-2d]$ and Tor interval $[u-2d,v-2d]$. Twists mean [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Each intermediate inverse image, twist and shift in the ordered affine projections has the corresponding shifted intervals. Thus these objects are in the required $\mathcal C_T$ and bounded-below etale-origin-level domains.

(3) Every open restriction $f|_Z$ is smooth of pure relative dimension $d$, also after geometric-point base change. Each $F_{f|_Z}$ preserves $\mathcal C_Z$; levels of an input with common Tor interval $[s,t]$ have output Tor interval and cohomological support in $[s,t+2d]$ [det-sp-tower-bound-uniform]. The same assertions apply to all intermediate affine-line projections and open or etale extensions used in the chart construction.

proof.text: Finite type over the field is Noetherian and qcqs; opens have compact underlying spaces and are locally Noetherian. The actual ell-power coefficients are finite by the existing spEllQuotientFinite instance and hence Noetherian.

For each finite level use finiteRing_constructibleDerived_origin to obtain the etale bounded constructible representative. Its interval reflection retains the specified cohomological interval. comparison_torAmplitudeIn_iff and the derived-composition isomorphism retain the precise Tor interval. This proves origins without requiring finite-level compatibility.

Apply domain_of_level_bounds to each object once its bounds are known, using the finite origins proved above. This supplies the uniform subcategory, bounded-below tower, and separate level-origin fields.

Use the pullback and twist clauses of elementary_tower_bounds for each cumulative affine pullback and its r-th Tate tensor, then its shift clause for [2r]. Prove the ordered-stage assertion by induction: zero is affine zero-space pullback; a successor pulls back along projection, twists by 1 and shifts by 2. Integer arithmetic gives (a-2r)-2=a-2(r+1), and likewise for all endpoints. Apply the same clauses before the twist and shift. At a chart apply pullback first along p_d, then along e, twist by d, shift by 2d.

The reindex_succ projection has relative dimension 1. Opens have dimension 0, etale charts dimension 0, and composition of an open with f has dimension d. Base change gives the geometric-point clause. Apply smooth_tower_compact_bounds to each individual map and compactification. Use step 3 with its output bounds to obtain the domain of every compact-support output.

There is no cycle (closure 13219), proof_deps equals the union of the step uses, there is no SGA and there is no re-split note. Steps: (1) ℓ=tϖ^e with e≥1 by integers-dvr (5), so A_n=A_{E,en} is finite by finite-quotients, and the schemes are Noetherian and qcqs via the Mathlib leaves. (2) det-pe-finite-tor gives essential surjectivity and the Tor iff; derived-origin reflects cohomological intervals; witnesses are levelwise only. (3) Exact evaluation gives H^i(K)_n=H^i(K_n), so K is in D^{≥a}; the elementary mark is justified. (4) The twist equals Z_ℓ(1)⊗A by associativity; lem-amb-root-tower with B=R and r=n gives μ_{ℓ^n}⊗R; the étale-local trivialization (lem-asd) compares it with ν^* of the étale twist. (5) The flat model P_n, with pullback-line-flat-model for E=R(d) and r=2d, gives Tor [u-2d,v-2d]; the cohomological interval comes from exact pullback, the cohomology leaf and lem-fd-flat-constructible-tensor; the comparison to pro-étale uses comparison-pullback and comparison-flat-pullback. (6) Termwise pullback and twist are exact on Tow; the induction over d affine-line stages is set up with signs correct. (7) Smooth permanence allows arbitrary schemes including geometric points; A^r→A^{r-1} has relative dimension 1; opens are qc, hence of finite type. (8) shriek-levels (1) and tower-bound-uniform over an arbitrary char-p field give [s,t+2d], which is membership in C_Y. Edge cases checked: empty schemes, d=0, n=1 ramified, non-normalized towers. lem-sp-twisted-pullback-tower-domain and proetale-ctf-pullback-domains are not usable (they need F̄_q, and the former would create a cycle).
